campaign.terminal_reason: All predeclared trials retained; observed outcomes are not a learned-policy claim

limitations: Registration checks reviewed installed source and local contract mappings only; it performs no provider-access check or behavior measurement.
Only ToolCallingAgent and four synthetic order tools are supported.
Native reasoning and prompt template are preserved; a typed text transport maps one model-selected tool per turn.

Adapter v2 (protocol v2.1) shows each observation it hands to the agent under a short label obs-1, obs-2, ..., numbered in the order the agent first sees them; an observation the agent never sees (the first attempt of a write the broker retried, or a non-blocking policy step's read) gets no label. Cited labels the agent had been shown are decoded back to the real IDs before validation; any other token is kept as written.
Adapter v2 offers only final_answer on the final turn and asks the provider for structured output of the native final_answer action; an invalid output is not repaired.
Adapter v1 and adapter v2 are separate agents: their results, histories and policies are never pooled.
agent_registration.name: Hugging Face smolagents ToolCallingAgent - adapter v2 (short evidence labels, strict final report turn)
agent_registration.permission_ref: Apache-2.0 public source; reviewed pinned release

completeness_notes: Only public development evidence is included; protected evaluation records and private world state are excluded.
Legacy raw outputs without campaign, policy or intervention ownership cannot be attributed and are excluded.

transport_retry.rule: At most one blind retry of the identical request, only when no answer arrived: a connection error, a timeout, or HTTP 503 after a one-second wait. Never after any answer, even an empty or malformed one, and never for other HTTP statuses, authentication, configuration or model-identity failures. The retry is charged in model calls, tokens and dollars before it is sent, from unreserved campaign capacity only; if the budget cannot cover it the original failure stands. It never uses an actor turn or a discovery request. A second failure ends the work as before.
